---
title: "coffee"
format: html

---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
coffee <- read_csv("coffee.csv")
print(colnames(coffee))
```


```{r setup, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
colnames(coffee) <- c("Country", "CupsPerDay")
library(sf)
library(rnaturalearth)
library(rnaturalearthdata)

world <- ne_countries(scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf")


world_coffee <- left_join(world, coffee, by = c("name" = "Country"))
```

## **Карта кофе: Чашек в день**

```{r map}
ggplot(world_coffee) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = CupsPerDay)) +
  scale_fill_gradient(name = "cups", low = "lightyellow", high = "blue", na.value = "grey90") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Карта потребления кофе по странам")
```
